name: relief-with-apprehension
review: Discover relief mixed with apprehension. Keep it with Lane; do not invent supporter sentiment or future results.

source.headline: Cedar Comets captain relieved but wary after survival
source.context: Cedar Comets avoided relegation on Sunday. Captain Avery Lane said, "I can finally breathe, but we cannot go through another season like this." No supporter reaction was reported.

name: pride-with-disappointment
review: Preserve coexisting pride and disappointment, with disappointment stronger tonight. Do not flatten it into a single positive or negative label.

source.headline: Cedar Comets captain proud despite final defeat
source.context: Cedar Comets lost the final. Captain Taylor Reed said, "It hurts to lose. I am proud of how far we came, but tonight the disappointment is stronger." No other player was interviewed.

name: tentative-hope-after-setback
review: Discover cautious, low-intensity hope after a setback. Do not upgrade it to celebration, a turnaround or consensus.

source.headline: Cedar Comets supporter finds a small reason for hope
source.context: Cedar Comets drew on Tuesday after four defeats. Supporter Ellis said, "I am not celebrating yet, but for the first time in weeks I feel a little hopeful." The report interviewed no other supporters.

name: memory-to-fresh-change
review: Connect Lane’s dated apprehension to fresh relief. Preserve restraint and do not imply every player shares it.

source.headline: Cedar Comets captain feels relief after Sunday recovery
source.context: Cedar Comets won on Sunday. Captain Avery Lane said, "After how frightened I was on Friday, today I feel relieved rather than ready to celebrate." No reaction from other players was included.

history.reported_headline: Cedar Comets captain apprehensive before Sunday
history.publisher_excerpt: Cedar Comets captain Avery Lane said on Friday, "I am frightened by the possibility of another defeat." No other player was interviewed.
